evidence.quote: Meld je uiterlijk 1 mei aan via Studielink.

notes: Tuition fee for non-EU/EEA students is not stated per amount on the supplied pages; the Collegegeld page only points to the collegegeldmeter and says instellingscollegegeld applies to students from outside the EER, so no tuition fact is given. The programme itself is Dutch-taught (Taal Nederlands); the page mentions an English-taught variant Electrical and Electronic Engineering as a separate programme. Deadlines for international students are on the Aanmeld-deadlines page under 'Deadlines for international students', but the list itself is not present in the text. Only one intake (September, deadline 1 mei 2027) is quoted; the page also mentions a February start with deadline 1 februari, but without a year it is not output. The oer.fontys.nl page contains no usable text.

note.fr: Diplôme néerlandais (havo, vwo ou mbo niveau 4) exigé; certaines matières/profils donnent des exigences supplémentaires. Vérifiez la page complète des toelatingseisen pour les diplômes étrangers (Bac marocain).
note.en: Dutch diploma (havo, vwo or mbo level 4) required; certain subjects/profiles add additional admission requirements. Check the full toelatingseisen page for foreign diplomas (Moroccan Baccalaureat).

evidence.quote: Met een havo-, vwo-, of mbo-diploma (niveau 4) word je toegelaten.
